<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.10"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="32" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="21" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">9:41</text>
  <line x1="322" y1="17" x2="322" y2="20" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="326" y1="14" x2="326" y2="20" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="11" x2="330" y2="20" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="344" cy="16" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="347" y1="19" x2="350" y2="22" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="359" y="11" width="22" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="361" y="13" width="16" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
  <rect x="382" y="14" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#4A4A4A"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="32" width="390" height="68" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points="31,66 22,74 31,82" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="23" y1="74" x2="43" y2="74" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="58" y="80" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Ethnicity</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="320" y="50" width="52" height="34" rx="17" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <text x="346" y="71" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">DONE</text>
  </g>
  <line x1="20" y1="100" x2="370" y2="100" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Intro -->
  <text x="22" y="132" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">What’s your ethnicity?</text>
  <text x="22" y="154" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Choose the option that best represents you.</text>

  <!-- Selection card -->
  <rect x="17" y="174" width="356" height="477" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
  <rect x="17" y="172" width="356" height="477" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

  <!-- Asian highlighted -->
  <rect x="29" y="184" width="332" height="54" rx="10" fill="#FFF0F4"/>
  <rect x="29" y="184" width="4" height="54" rx="2" fill="#FE3675"/>
  <text x="48" y="217" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Asian</text>
  <circle cx="338" cy="211" r="11" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
  <polyline points="332,211 336,215 344,207" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <line x1="29" y1="249" x2="361" y2="249" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="48" y="283" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Black / African Descent</text>
  <circle cx="338" cy="277" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <line x1="29" y1="305" x2="361" y2="305" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="48" y="339" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Hispanic / Latino</text>
  <circle cx="338" cy="333" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <line x1="29" y1="361" x2="361" y2="361" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="48" y="395" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Middle Eastern</text>
  <circle cx="338" cy="389" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <line x1="29" y1="417" x2="361" y2="417" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="48" y="451" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Native American</text>
  <circle cx="338" cy="445" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <line x1="29" y1="473" x2="361" y2="473" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="48" y="507" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">White</text>
  <circle cx="338" cy="501" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <line x1="29" y1="529" x2="361" y2="529" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="48" y="563" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Prefer not to say</text>
  <circle cx="338" cy="557" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <text x="32" y="625" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">You can change this anytime in your profile settings.</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="770" width="390" height="74" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="770" x2="390" y2="770" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Discover -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,796 49,791 54,801 44,806" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="798" r="2" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="46" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">DISCOVER</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Likes -->
  <g>
    <path d="M113 806 C105 800 106 792 112 792 C116 792 118 795 118 795 C118 795 120 792 124 792 C130 792 131 800 123 806 L118 810 Z" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="118" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">LIKES</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Matches -->
  <g>
    <rect x="177" y="792" width="22" height="14" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polygon points="181,806 181,810 186,806" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="188" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">MATCHES</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Profile -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="267" cy="796" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="267" cy="806" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="267" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FE3675">PROFILE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Settings -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="337" cy="798" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="337" cy="798" r="2.5" fill="#939393"/>
    <line x1="337" y1="787" x2="337" y2="791" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="337" y1="805" x2="337" y2="809" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="798" x2="330" y2="798" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="344" y1="798" x2="348" y2="798" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="337" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">SETTINGS</text>
  </g>
</svg>
